tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch10:10-2↗ prob:taylor-series-metric-tensor ↗ prob:associated-quadratic-form Suppose $(M, g)$ is a Riemannian manifold and $p \in M$. Let $S_\Pi \subseteq M$ be the 2-dimensional submanifold obtained by applying the exponential map to a plane $\Pi \subseteq T_p M$, as on page 250. For sufficiently small $r$, let $A(r)$ be the area of the geodesic disk of radius $r$ about $p$ in $S_\Pi $ with its induced metric. Using the results of Problems 10-1 and 8-21, find the Taylor series of $A(r)$ to fourth order in $r$. Then use this result to express $\sec (\Pi )$ in terms of a limit involving the difference $\pi r^2 - A(r)$. \end{exercise}
